keyEvents.text: Goal! Bournemouth 1, Nottingham Forest 0. Evanilson (Bournemouth) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by James Hill with a headed pass.
Delay in match because of an injury Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Liam Delap (Nottingham Forest) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Bournemouth 2, Nottingham Forest 0. Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Marcus Tavernier following a fast break.
First Half ends, Bournemouth 2, Nottingham Forest 0.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Igor Jesus replaces Dan Ndoye.
Substitution, Nottingham Forest. Xaver Schlager replaces Ryan Yates.
Daniel Muñoz (Nottingham Forest) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
